BREAKING: Crude oil inventories in the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve officially fall below 290 million barrels for the first time since 1982.

Inventories declined by another 3.7 million barrels last week, to 289.7 million barrels.

US oil reserves are at a fresh 40+ year low.
